dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: *sigh* Only after following Captain Beidou across the lands did I realize that Liyue was best...

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Well, I say that, but I've never really gotten off the boat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, as for that next leg of the journey...

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Nope, sorry, that's confidential. I can only tell you that we're going to Sumeru next.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: I can't say much more, and I'd suggest that you refrain from asking.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Alright. Hope things go well with you!
